svg.aria-label: Source files that run during boot, in order: in trusted-firmware-a the BL2 files for the FIP lookup, DDR training and image placement; the BL31 monitor and the OP-TEE dispatcher; in optee_os and scp-firmware the platform configuration, the SCMI server and its pseudo trusted application; in u-boot the boot-device detection, the distro boot script, sysboot and booti; and in linux the device tree, the SCMI over OP-TEE transport, the SCMI clock driver, the SD card and serial drivers, and kernel_init.
svg.text: The code that runs, in order: power-on to /sbin/init
The files to open when you want to understand or change a step. Paths are inside build/src/ after ./build.sh firmware and ./build.sh kernel.
finds the FIP: partition type GUID first, then the name "fip"
stm32mp2_ddr_probe(): bring up the LPDDR4 controller and PHY
which image goes where; BL33_MODE is MODE_EL1 when STM32MP_BL33_EL1=1
generic start-up of the resident monitor; ends by running the next image
opteed_setup() / opteed_init() / opteed_smc_handler(): the OP-TEE dispatcher
the STM32 SiP service (its own UUID), reachable through smc
CFG_TZDRAM_START=0x82000000; SCMI server product stm32mp2; 64-bit TAs only
plat_console_init(): early UART console; maps the GIC; prints the platform banner
the board as the secure world sees it (compiled into the OP-TEE image)
scmi_server_initialize(): the SCMI server runs inside the OP-TEE core
the pseudo trusted application Linux and U-Boot call to deliver SCMI messages
wires SCMI clock and reset requests to OP-TEE's own clock and reset drivers
from the ROM's boot context sets env boot_device (serial, usb, mmc …) and boot_instance
do_sysboot(): parse extlinux.conf, load Image and DTB
do_booti(): hand the DTB to the kernel in x0 and jump
U-Boot is an SCMI client of OP-TEE too (scmi node in arch/arm/dts/stm32mp25-u-boot.dtsi)
scmi_optee_send_message(): one SCMI message becomes one call into OP-TEE
scmi_clk_enable(): clk_enable() on an SCMI clock ends here
mmci_probe(): the SD card controller (its supply is an SCMI regulator)
Open any of them with: less build/src/<repo>/<path>. Handy searches: grep -rn "scmi-optee" build/src/linux-6.18.58/drivers/firmware/arm_scmi/ ·
